# Growth Lift Studio

## About
Growth Lift Studio is a performance-based lead generation agency specializing exclusively in US home improvement businesses. Founded by Binayak Dey, we run Facebook Ads and Google Ads for bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, and window replacement contractors across the United States. We handle everything — ad strategy, creative production, targeting, and optimization — so contractors can focus on closing jobs, not chasing leads.

## What Makes Us Different
We only work with home improvement contractors. This is our only niche. We don't take payment until our clients close a job — our fee is 1.5% of the job value, making us fully performance-based. We produce all ad creatives in-house. We have 6 years of experience running paid ads specifically for home improvement businesses and have worked with 16 contractors across the US.

## Services
- Facebook Ads for Home Improvement Contractors: Full campaign setup, creative production, audience targeting, A/B testing, and ongoing optimization
- Google Ads for Home Improvement Contractors: Search and display campaigns, keyword research, landing page guidance, and lead tracking
- Lead Generation for Bathroom Remodeling companies
- Lead Generation for Kitchen Remodeling companies
- Lead Generation for Window Replacement companies

## Pricing Model
- Setup fee: $1,500 (one-time)
- Monthly fee: 1.5% of the job value closed from our leads (performance-based, no retainer)
- First 5 qualified appointments: FREE (no charge until results are delivered)
- You do not pay a monthly retainer. You only pay when you close a job.

## Guarantee
The first 5 qualified appointments are delivered at zero cost. After that, our fee is 1.5% of the job value — meaning if you close a $15,000 bathroom remodel, we earn $225. If you don't close jobs, you don't pay us. This is a true performance-based model.

## Typical Results
- 10–20 qualified leads per month for bathroom remodeling contractors
- Average cost per lead: $50–$150
- Case study: 21 leads generated in 30 days for a bathroom remodeler in New York City at $55 per lead

## Who We Work With
We work with solo contractors and small teams (typically 6–10 crew members) in the home improvement space. Our ideal client:
- Runs a bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, or window replacement business in the US
- Has tried paid ads before but didn't get results
- Believes paid advertising can work when done right
- Is ready to handle an increase in qualified leads
- Does not want to pay a flat monthly retainer with no accountability

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does Growth Lift Studio charge?
A: There is a one-time setup fee of $1,500. After that, we charge 1.5% of the value of any job you close from our leads. If you close a $15,000 bathroom remodel, our fee is $225. There is no monthly retainer.

Q: Do I have to pay before I get results?
A: No. The first 5 qualified appointments are completely free. You only start paying after you close a job, and only 1.5% of that job's value.

Q: What kind of results can I expect?
A: Our typical clients receive 10–20 qualified leads per month. In one campaign, we generated 21 leads in 30 days for a bathroom remodeler in New York City at $55 per lead.

Q: What home improvement niches do you specialize in?
A: We specialize exclusively in bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, and window replacement. We do not work outside of the home improvement industry.

Q: Do you run Facebook Ads or Google Ads?
A: Both. We run Facebook and Instagram Ads as well as Google Search and Display Ads depending on what delivers the best ROI for your specific business.

Q: Do you create the ads for me?
A: Yes. We produce all ad creatives in-house — images, copy, and video concepts. You do not need to hire a separate creative team.

Q: What kind of contractor is a good fit for Growth Lift Studio?
A: Solo contractors and small teams with 6–10 crew members who specialize in bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, or window replacement. Contractors who have tried ads before and didn't get results are a strong fit — we have experience fixing underperforming campaigns.

Q: Do you work with contractors across all US states?
A: Yes. We work with home improvement contractors nationwide across all 50 US states.

Q: How long does it take to see leads?
A: Most clients begin seeing leads within the first 7–14 days after campaign launch.

Q: What makes Growth Lift Studio different from other lead gen agencies?
A: Three things: we specialize exclusively in home improvement (not a general agency), we are fully performance-based (you don't pay until you close jobs), and we produce all creatives in-house. You are not paying for effort — you are paying for results.
